system.description:
Each use creates a remove curse effect on the wearer only, as if cast by a 36th-level cleric. It does not affect other creatures, and it cannot curse a target.

The armor has 3 charges in total. When this power is part of the armor, the armor itself cannot be cursed. Spending a charge is the armor's charge count. There is no separate remove-curse resolver.
system.effect: Remove one curse from the wearer
